summary: @or-sdk/api-tokens-lambda preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: Package advertises itself as a small AWS Lambda API-tokens wrapper (dist/cjs/ApiTokensLambda.js). package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is identifier-obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0x... names, property-lookup wrapper objects hiding strings such as "ldd", "--version", "/etc/os-release", "Alpine", "musl", and URL fragments); it downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated bundle using string-array rotation (function WV8StW rotates an n7gIxM constant array; identifiers MmgoCP/etDiOOB/JqTtnbZ). math_init.js is not referenced by dist/cjs/index.js or any other library code; its only invocation path is the Bun binary fetched at preinstall. The package's advertised purpose (AWS Lambda wrapper) does not require Bun, and fetching a second runtime purely to execute an obfuscated bundled payload during npm install both grants install-time code execution on every installer host and evades Node-focused static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
